description: Find the aspect ratio of any size, or the width or height that keeps a ratio. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

height.description: Height in the same unit as width. With width and no ratio: returns the aspect ratio. With a ratio and no width: returns the width that keeps the ratio.

nearestWithinPercent.description: When describing a size: how far, in percent, it may be from a common named ratio (16:9, 4:3, 21:9 …) and still be reported as `nearest`. 1366 × 768 is 0.05 % from 16:9. Past this, nearest is null.

ratio.description: An aspect ratio to resize to, written "16:9", "4:3", "2.39:1" or "16/9". Give it with exactly one of width or height and the other side comes back as exact, rounded (whole) and even (for video encoders).

width.description: Width in any unit (usually pixels). With height and no ratio: returns the aspect ratio of that size. With a ratio and no height: returns the height that keeps the ratio.

name: aspect_ratio_calculator
title: Aspect Ratio Calculator
